name: upx
description: Ultimate executable packer with high compression ratios and fast decompression

tools.description: Compress executables and shared libraries to reduce file size while maintaining functionality
tools.usage:
upx program.exe # Compress executable with default settings
upx --best program.exe # Maximum compression
upx -d packed.exe # Decompress/unpack executable
upx -t packed.exe # Test packed executable integrity
upx --info packed.exe # Show packing information
